generate_text_gemini: generate text using the GeminiAPI class with a prompt string and optional temperature and max_tokens parameters
chat_gemini_api: chat with the GeminiAPI class using a sequence of messages and an optional formatter for conversation history
embed_content_gemini: embed content using the GeminiAPI class to produce a sequence of floats representing the text embedding
count_tokens_gemini: count tokens in a string or chunk list using the GeminiAPI class with the generate model
register_gemini_backend: register the GeminiAPI backend to configure LLM builtins with generate_text, chat, embed, and count_tokens methods
